title: Solution & data page, with editing
request: Every project page keeps the demo's look but shows the open project's own records; a page with no result yet says so and offers to run what is missing, and nothing is filled with sample numbers. This package wires the Solution & data page and lets the user edit the solution there instead of in the old UI.
spec: The saved solution, the data and the column audit; an editor that saves through the validator and asks before clearing completed stages. Done when editing the target saves, logs set_solution allowed, and works for a project built from an upload.
plan: Fill the page's panels from the open project (solution sheet, owner questions, known-when timeline, sign-off with versions, data and split), keeping the sample markup to restore.
Show empty states with a run button when a stage has not run.
Add 'Edit the solution' in the page's drawer saving with PUT /api/projects/{id}/solution.
When the target changes, fetch the task and metric from the proposal; keep the user's edits when they ask for the audit again; confirm before clearing completed stages.
Make the proposal route work for projects whose suggestion holds only what the chat established.

decisions.decision: A 'Sign this version' button was added though the sample has none.
decisions.why: Signing the solution is a real gate in the graph; the page needed a way to pass it, and the owner was told so it could be dropped.

decisions.decision: Cost amounts in the calculator are labelled 'examples to replace'.
decisions.why: They are the only example values on a real page and must not pass for project numbers.

change: views/solution.html (and audit.html) wired to the project; the solution editor in the drawer saves through PUT /solution so the validator logs the change.

findings.defect: 'Audit again' on the Solution page crashed for every project built from an upload.
findings.scenario: A project built from Home holds a suggestion with only what the chat established (no sample suggestion); asking the audit again raised on the missing fields.
findings.cause: The route assumed a studied sample's full suggestion.
findings.fix: The proposal route works from what the chat established.
findings.impact: Every project built through Home, the main path for new users, raised when the user asked for the column audit again after changing the target. The user was left with an audit for the old target and no way to refresh it from the Solution page.

findings.defect: Changing the solution sent people to the old UI at /classic.
findings.scenario: On a real project, 'Edit the solution' linked to /classic#project/<id> to change the target, forbidden columns or metric.
findings.cause: The page was wired before the editor was built.
findings.fix: The editor opens in the page's drawer and saves through PUT /solution; when the target changes it fetches the task and metric first, and it asks before clearing completed stages.
findings.impact: A user on a real project who needed to change the target, forbidden columns or metric was sent to the old UI, which 8.3 later removed. Without the editor, the solution of a real project could not be changed from any product page.

outcome: Done: the Solution & data page shows the project's solution and edits it through the validator.
lessons: A project built by a new path (Home) carries less context than one built by the old path; test every route on both.
risks: An editor that saves the solution by any route other than PUT /solution would change the project without the validator logging set_solution.
Changing the target clears completed stages; saving without asking would throw away results the user did not mean to lose.
Projects built from Home carry only what the chat established, so routes written for studied samples may assume fields that are not there.
Example cost figures in the calculator could be read as the project's own numbers.
A control the demo lacks (the sign-off button) changes the frozen design and needs the owner's agreement.
